There are no top-level commands, process substitutions, or dynamic evaluations (like `$(...)` or backticks) outside of function scopes. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD during `makepkg --printsrcinfo` will not trigger any unintended or malicious behavior.

No evidence of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or unsafe operations occurs at parse time. All potentially active code is confined within the `package()` function, which is not executed during this phase and will be audited separately later.
